PLAN "Post-MI General Fitness 12-Week Programme with Cardiac Nutrition, Enhanced Strength, Compound Lifts, and Optimized Cardio"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Build general strength and fitness safely post-MI"
  GOAL secondary nutrition:
    name "Support cardiac health with balanced nutrition"
  GOAL tertiary weight_loss:
    name "Promote safe weight loss with increased cardio volume"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1: Adaptation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1-2:
      DAY Monday "Full Body A + Cardio":
        - walking 10m brisk (warmup)
        - squat 2x10 rpe 5
        - leg_press 2x12 rpe 5
        - chest_fly 2x12 rpe 5
        - seated_row 2x12 rpe 5
        - shoulder_press 2x12 rpe 5
        - calf_raise 2x15 rpe 5
        - plank 2x20..25 rpe 5
        - cycling 15..17m moderate (cardio)
        - hamstring_stretch 3m, chest_stretch 2m (cooldown)
      DAY Thursday "Full Body B + Cardio":
        - cycling 10m brisk (warmup)
        - deadlift 2x8 rpe 5
        - goblet_squat 2x12 rpe 5
        - dumbbell_row 2x12 rpe 5
        - incline_press 2x12 rpe 5
        - lat_pulldown 2x12 rpe 5
        - glute_bridge 2x15 rpe 5
        - bird_dog 2x10..12 rpe 5
        - walking 15..17m brisk (cardio)
        - quad_stretch 3m, shoulder_stretch 2m (cooldown)
      DAY Saturday "Cardio Only":
        - walking 5m brisk (warmup)
        - cycling 25..27m moderate (cardio)
        - hamstring_stretch 2m, back_stretch 2m (cooldown)
    WEEK 3-4:
      DAY Monday "Full Body A + Cardio":
        - walking 10m brisk (warmup)
        - squat 3x8 rpe 6
        - leg_press 3x10 rpe 6
        - chest_fly 3x10 rpe 6
        - seated_row 3x10 rpe 6
        - shoulder_press 3x10 rpe 6
        - calf_raise 2..3x15 rpe 6
        - plank 2x30..35 rpe 6
        - cycling 19..21m moderate (cardio)
        - hamstring_stretch 3m, chest_stretch 2m (cooldown)
      DAY Thursday "Full Body B + Cardio":
        - cycling 10m brisk (warmup)
        - deadlift 3x8 rpe 6
        - goblet_squat 3x10 rpe 6
        - dumbbell_row 3x10 rpe 6
        - incline_press 3x10 rpe 6
        - lat_pulldown 3x10 rpe 6
        - glute_bridge 2..3x15 rpe 6
        - bird_dog 2x14..16 rpe 6
        - walking 19..21m brisk (cardio)
        - quad_stretch 3m, shoulder_stretch 2m (cooldown)
      DAY Saturday "Cardio Only":
        - walking 5m brisk (warmup)
        - cycling 29..31m moderate (cardio)
        - hamstring_stretch 2m, back_stretch 2m (cooldown)

  PHASE "Phase 2: Progression" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5-6:
      DAY Monday "Full Body A + Cardio":
        - walking 12m brisk (warmup)
        - squat 3x10 rpe 6
        - leg_press 3x12 rpe 6
        - chest_fly 3x12 rpe 6
        - seated_row 3x12 rpe 6
        - shoulder_press 3x12 rpe 6
        - calf_raise 3x15 rpe 6
        - plank 3x25..30 rpe 6
        - cycling 23..25m moderate (cardio)
        - hamstring_stretch 3m, chest_stretch 2m (cooldown)
      DAY Thursday "Full Body B + Cardio":
        - cycling 12m brisk (warmup)
        - deadlift 3x8 rpe 6
        - goblet_squat 3x12 rpe 6
        - dumbbell_row 3x12 rpe 6
        - incline_press 3x12 rpe 6
        - lat_pulldown 3x12 rpe 6
        - glute_bridge 3x15 rpe 6
        - bird_dog 3x10..12 rpe 6
        - walking 23..25m brisk (cardio)
        - quad_stretch 3m, shoulder_stretch 2m (cooldown)
      DAY Saturday "Cardio Only":
        - walking 5m brisk (warmup)
        - cycling 33..35m moderate (cardio)
        - hamstring_stretch 2m, back_stretch 2m (cooldown)
    WEEK 7-8:
      DAY Monday "Full Body A + Cardio":
        - walking 12m brisk (warmup)
        - squat 3x12 rpe 6
        - leg_press 3x12 rpe 6
        - chest_fly 3x12 rpe 6
        - seated_row 3x12 rpe 6
        - shoulder_press 3x12 rpe 6
        - calf_raise 3x15 rpe 6
        - plank 3x35..40 rpe 6
        - cycling 27..29m moderate (cardio)
        - hamstring_stretch 3m, chest_stretch 2m (cooldown)
      DAY Thursday "Full Body B + Cardio":
        - cycling 12m brisk (warmup)
        - deadlift 3x10 rpe 6
        - goblet_squat 3x12 rpe 6
        - dumbbell_row 3x12 rpe 6
        - incline_press 3x12 rpe 6
        - lat_pulldown 3x12 rpe 6
        - glute_bridge 3x15 rpe 6
        - bird_dog 3x14..16 rpe 6
        - walking 27..29m brisk (cardio)
        - quad_stretch 3m, shoulder_stretch 2m (cooldown)
      DAY Saturday "Cardio Only":
        - walking 5m brisk (warmup)
        - cycling 37..39m moderate (cardio)
        - hamstring_stretch 2m, back_stretch 2m (cooldown)

  PHASE "Phase 3: Consolidation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 9-10:
      DAY Monday "Full Body A + Cardio":
        - walking 15m brisk (warmup)
        - squat 3x12 rpe 7
        - leg_press 3x15 rpe 7
        - chest_fly 3x15 rpe 7
        - seated_row 3x15 rpe 7
        - shoulder_press 3x15 rpe 7
        - calf_raise 3x18 rpe 7
        - plank 3x45..50 rpe 7
        - cycling 30..32m moderate (cardio)
        - hamstring_stretch 3m, chest_stretch 2m (cooldown)
      DAY Thursday "Full Body B + Cardio":
        - cycling 15m brisk (warmup)
        - deadlift 3x10 rpe 7
        - goblet_squat 3x15 rpe 7
        - dumbbell_row 3x15 rpe 7
        - incline_press 3x15 rpe 7
        - lat_pulldown 3x15 rpe 7
        - glute_bridge 3x18 rpe 7
        - bird_dog 3x18..20 rpe 7
        - walking 30..32m brisk (cardio)
        - quad_stretch 3m, shoulder_stretch 2m (cooldown)
      DAY Saturday "Cardio Only":
        - walking 5m brisk (warmup)
        - cycling 45..47m moderate (cardio)
        - hamstring_stretch 2m, back_stretch 2m (cooldown)
    WEEK 11-12:
      DAY Monday "Full Body A + Cardio":
        - walking 15m brisk (warmup)
        - squat 3x12 rpe 7
        - leg_press 3x15 rpe 7
        - chest_fly 3x15 rpe 7
        - seated_row 3x15 rpe 7
        - shoulder_press 3x15 rpe 7
        - calf_raise 3x18 rpe 7
        - plank 3x55..60 rpe 7
        - cycling 34..36m moderate (cardio)
        - hamstring_stretch 3m, chest_stretch 2m (cooldown)
      DAY Thursday "Full Body B + Cardio":
        - cycling 15m brisk (warmup)
        - deadlift 3x12 rpe 7
        - goblet_squat 3x15 rpe 7
        - dumbbell_row 3x15 rpe 7
        - incline_press 3x15 rpe 7
        - lat_pulldown 3x15 rpe 7
        - glute_bridge 3x18 rpe 7
        - bird_dog 3x22..24 rpe 7
        - walking 34..36m brisk (cardio)
        - quad_stretch 3m, shoulder_stretch 2m (cooldown)
      DAY Saturday "Cardio Only":
        - walking 5m brisk (warmup)
        - cycling 49..51m moderate (cardio)
        - hamstring_stretch 2m, back_stretch 2m (cooldown)

NUTRITION cardiac_health:
  GUIDELINES:
    - Emphasize vegetables, fruits, whole grains, legumes, and nuts daily
    - Prioritize lean protein: fish (especially fatty fish 2x/week), skinless poultry, beans, tofu
    - Use olive oil or canola oil as primary fat source; avoid trans fats and minimize saturated fat
    - Limit sodium to <2000mg/day; avoid processed and packaged foods
    - Choose low-fat or nonfat dairy
    - Avoid added sugars and sugar-sweetened beverages
    - Limit red meat and processed meats
    - Hydrate with water; limit caffeine to 1–2 cups/day, avoid energy drinks
    - Alcohol: none or as per cardiologist guidance
    - Portion control: eat until satisfied, not stuffed
    - Aim for 25–35g fiber daily
  SAMPLE_DAY:
    breakfast:
      - oatmeal with berries and walnuts
      - low-fat milk or fortified soy milk
    snack:
      - apple or banana
      - small handful unsalted almonds
    lunch:
      - grilled salmon or chickpea salad
      - quinoa or brown rice
      - steamed broccoli and carrots
      - olive oil vinaigrette
    snack:
      - low-fat yogurt or hummus with carrot sticks
    dinner:
      - baked chicken breast or lentil stew
      - roasted sweet potato
      - mixed green salad with tomatoes, cucumber, olive oil
    snack:
      - fresh fruit or small bowl of berries
      - herbal tea
  NOTES:
    - Consult with a registered dietitian for individualization and medication interactions
    - Monitor blood pressure and weight regularly
    - Adjust portions for weight management as needed
